title: Bloch 2006, the binary-search midpoint overflow
violates: The midpoint stays between its bounds: `low ≤ mid ≤ high`.
because: `low + high` exceeds the largest 32-bit `int`, so the sum wraps to a negative number before it is halved.
class: a midpoint that leaves its bounds when the sum overflows

cured_by.text: Write `low + (high − low) / 2`, or shift the sum right as an unsigned number (`LShR(low + high, 1)`, Java's `>>>`).

also.caption: With `low + (high − low) / 2` the query has no witness.
With the logical shift the query has no witness either.

minimal.why: a dated incident kept as a toy model

source.title: Bloch, Extra, Extra: Read All About It, Nearly All Binary Searches and Mergesorts are Broken
